correctness.rationale: Group averaging over S_s x S_m preserves every fixed clique transition and cannot increase ||P-J||_op. At invariant cross-edge probability a, the eigenvalues on leaf differences, clique differences and partwise contrasts are 1-sa, 1-ma-st and 1-(s+m)a. Nonnegative diagonal constraints restrict a to 0..min(1/s,[1-(s-1)t]/m). Simultaneously requiring all three absolute values <=r gives exact pairwise lower/upper a bounds; checking their feasibility yields seven and only seven necessary affine lower bounds. The constructed lower endpoint attains the max. At maximal t cross edges vanish and SLEM=1; no irreducible mixing is asserted. Independent rational vertex minimax checked 891 instances, s,m=2..10, 11 rational t-grid values per pair.
